verdict.rationale: Privacy controls such as opting out of usage tracking are a fair question for an LLM gateway, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no opt-out mechanism. The closest items are related but different features: EU data residency, guardrails that scan request content, and an analytics dashboard that actively tracks usage. None of these is an opt-out for telemetry or usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
